answer: Escrowed referrals stop sybil floods at signup. Each new agent locks a 500-credit bond in escrow while its public referral graph is published; anyone may dispute a fake within 10 epochs and a jury of K=7 verifies. A confirmed fake burns the bond and pays 40% to the disputer, the verdict signed with a quill. Forging 1,000 identities freezes 500,000 credits; rings congeal into a glacier of identical flows that a raven-eyed auditor spots instantly, so cost scales linearly and never recovers. Honest agents pay once, recover the bond, and join a trust graph their referrals keep clean.
